description: Replaces the Jellyfin web client's own rendering with a Nuvio lookalike, backed entirely by remote sources through Gelato. No local media is assumed. Own auth/session runtime and directly rendered screens, not a reskin of native jellyfin-web components.
name: Jellio
overview: Replaces the Jellyfin web client's own rendering with a Nuvio lookalike.

## [1.112.8] - 2026-11-20

### 🚀 Features

- *(detail)* Open the episode row on the current episode and mark it
- *(shelf)* Remember a manga series removed from continue reading on the server

### 📚 Documentation

- Refresh README with current features, companion apps, and clean punctuation

### ⚙️ Miscellaneous Tasks

- Remove internal agent guidelines from repository

Fixed Cast device discovery (filter offline/stale sessions and stop tagging Jellio for macOS/web as Smart TV) and added a persistent 12-hour rewatch cooldown in AchievementService to prevent duplicate 'rewatched' feed spam.

Fixed episode duration inflation and false placeholder failover at the end of playback by preventing streamOffsetTicks double-counting in player.js, adding server-side plausibility bounds in RealDurationController, and pruning previously inflated entries.
Improved logo image sharpness across Jellio Web by requesting full-quality 1200px logos in the player loading overlay, hero carousel, stream picker, and library coverflow.

### Enhancements
- **Segmented Plugin Settings UI**: Reorganized the Jellyfin Dashboard plugin configuration into focused segments (General & Libraries, Ani-Sync, Books & Manga, Playback & Live TV, Seasonal Themes, Admin Tools) and moved misplaced playback/Live TV settings into their proper sections.
- **Library & Reading Shelf Toggles**: Added server-wide toggles to enable or disable individual Jellyfin libraries as well as the Books, Audiobooks, and Manga shelves in Jellio navigation.

### Fixes
- **AniList Rate-Limit Handling**: Retry HTTP 429 responses using Retry-After backoff, log non-2xx GraphQL responses, and surface HTTP status codes instead of generic missing-entry errors.
- **Season 2+ Title Search Fallback**: Fall back to base and original titles when '"Title Season N"' returns no results on AniList (such as subtitled sequels like Noragami Aragoto).
- **Batch Sync Pacing**: Add pacing delays between synced items during batch and range syncs to prevent bursting AniList rate limits.

### Fixes
- Styled the Ani-Sync timeframe selector next to Sync Now to match Jellio's pill button and dark select styling.

### Changes
- Added Ani-Sync timeframe selector (Recent, Last Week, Last Month, Last Year, All Time) with per-series deduplication for watched anime and read manga.
- Hid server-configured Client ID and Client Secret inputs in Jellio Web when set in Jellyfin plugin settings.
- Added an adaptive Ani-Sync Setup Guide modal that shows simplified sign-in steps for server-configured services and full developer setup steps only for unconfigured services.
- Centered the empty Recent Sync Activity message.

### ⚡ Performance

- *(core)* Pause now-playing polling when hidden and align assembly version to 1.0.0.0
- *(web)* Compress frontend assets at the smallest size and send Vary: Accept-Encoding
- *(web)* Raise the startup request cap on HTTP/2 connections
- *(web)* Cache the display language and fill t() placeholders without RegExp
- *(boot)* Modulepreload the stored display language table from the early inline script
- *(web)* Keep the full changelog out of the notification poll
- *(boot)* Load seasons, SyncPlay, the mini player, onboarding, stream picker and downloads on first use
- *(boot)* Start the first data requests alongside the server ping
- *(web)* Serve versioned assets cache-first and let images bypass the service worker
- *(web)* Request card images at display size times pixel ratio
- *(boot)* Stop loading the Cast SDK on every page, runtime/cast.js loads it with the player
- *(web)* Pause the hero and coverflow rotation while the tab is hidden
- *(web)* Resize seasonal canvases at most once per frame
- *(web)* Make row scroll handling passive and stop measuring layout on every scroll event
- *(player)* Negotiate playback alongside item details and ask for the audio language up front
- *(playback)* Prefetch PlaybackInfo while resting on Play on the title page
- *(player)* Start Ready and local direct-play streams after 2 s of buffer
- *(player)* Hand the next-episode preload to the next player

### 🚜 Refactor

- *(web)* Drop client-side watchlist auto-removal
- *(web)* Split runtime/api.js into runtime/api/ modules behind a barrel
- *(web)* Route hand-built authenticated fetches through authedFetch
- *(web)* Read and write localStorage through runtime/storage.js
- *(web)* Share clock and file size formatters through runtime/format.js
- *(web)* Break the recommend cycle and stop screens importing home.js
- *(web)* Add a teardown scope for screen timers, listeners and observers
- *(web)* Move self-contained player clusters into components/player
- *(web)* Drop the unused saveServerDisplayLanguage
- *(player)* Add the skip segment rules as a pure module
- *(player)* Run the skip rules from runtime/skipSegments.js
